description: This file declares functions, constants, and includes necessary headers related to upstream interface management in a WAN manager module. It defines physical types and functions for handling upstream interface toggling and type conversions.

methods.name: string_to_physical_type
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a physical type to its enum value.

methods.name: physical_type_to_string
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a physical type enum.

methods.name: phys_type_to_flag
methods.description: Returns a flag string associated with a physical type.

methods.name: physical_reference_used
methods.description: Checks if a physical reference is currently used.

methods.name: toggle_upstream_intf
methods.description: Enables or disables the upstream interface based on the provided WAN mode object.
